title: A Low-Res Disappointment
text: A Low-Res Disappointment. Our 14 year old family geek recently redid his room and has had his eye out for decorative stuff to use there. His taste is quirky enough that I didn't know if he would go for this tapestry or not. As soon as he saw it though, he was like "Yeah, let's get this." Sadly, the tapestry was a disappointment. Think of a Hi-Res and a Low-Res photo of the same object. The first tends to be rich in sharply defined details while the second looks like a more mushy version of the first. If you can't picture what I mean, just go to Google Images and use "hi res vs low res" as your search keywords. This tapestry is not as blurred as the most extreme examples but it did seem as mushy as some of the less extreme samples there. The fabric seemed pretty lightweight, and is thin enough that a light behind it washes out the image on the front. So this would need to be hung on a wall and not over a window or across a closet. Our 14 year old took the tapestry to use on his wall but only until he can find something better.

features: Wall art size 52 inches x 60 inches
Hang with thumb tacks, hooks, or nails
Perfect for dorms, bedrooms, and living spaces
description: Log Large Tapestry by RoomMates is a gorgeous, fast and easy way to personalize your bedroom, dorm room, or living space. This large wall hanging will immediately become an important focal point of your room. To hang the polyester tapestry, simply use small thumb tacks, hooks, or nails. The versatile piece isn’t limited to walls either. You can also use it as a window cover, table cloth, couch cover, or throw blanket. With so many options, a wall tapestry is the perfect addition to your room’s decor.
